name: CoA super-track patch: The Sacred Flame's arrow moves to the Ashenvale Moonwell (#7722)
contract: The in-world arrow and minimap pin come from the client's SuperTrack.dbc, which the login patch stream overrides from coa_client_super_track (AscensionCompat.cpp:4646); the world-map markers stay the server's quest_poi rows.

Quest 1195 'The Sacred Flame' binds its only objective to SuperTrack point 4599 (QuestSuperTrack row 2865, field 2), and the client places 4599 at Raynewood Retreat (2377.6299, -1665.83, 142.128). The issue reports that arrow while the world map marks the Ashenvale Moonwell, and quest_poi id 2 (ObjectiveIndex 5, point 1888 -1776) agrees with the map.
Gameobject 20806 'Ashenvale Moonwell' stands at (1870.43, -1771.57, 61.328), where the issue's coordinates point, so the override moves 4599 there.

Row 4599 is referenced by exactly one objective in the whole client table, so nothing else moves. The login patch stream sends coa_client_super_track rows as SMSG_PATCH_SUPER_TRACK (0x06BE) records; socketless packet construction does not establish how the client renders the waypoint.

steps.label: The login stream sends SuperTrack row 4599 once
Row 4599 x is the Ashenvale Moonwell's 1870.43
Row 4599 y is the Ashenvale Moonwell's -1771.57
